messages:
mara: Heads up — finance spotted a surprise EU network/egress surcharge on last month's invoice. Total delta ~+12%. Any quick explanation? @lucy @aj
billing-bot: Automated invoice alert: EU Network Surcharge detected. Line item: network_fee_eu = $92,341 (+18% vs prior month).
aj: I noticed the same line. Provider rolled out a per-GB cross-AZ egress surcharge on a subset of instance families on Feb 1. Will trace which clusters are emitting the most.
lucy: quick check: provider doc shows EU egress price moved 0.090 -> 0.125 $/GB on Feb 1. Our EU fleet uses ~740 TB/mo egress. Rough delta =~ (0.125-0.09)*740,000 GB = $25.9k/mo — matches invoice movement.
mara: ok — how does that map to unit economics? need per-request and per-tier margin impact so finance can propose packaging changes.
sanjay: rough back-of-envelope — converting to per-request:
```
# estimate (very rough)
egress_gb_per_month = 740
delta_per_gb = 0.035
monthly_delta = egress_gb_per_month * delta_per_gb  # ~25,900 USD
requests_per_month = 3_200_000
delta_per_request = monthly_delta / requests_per_month  # ~0.0081 USD/request
```
mara: ~$0.008 per request is non-trivial for PLG pricing. If we absorb, it eats gross margin; if we pass through it hurts conversion. Need scenario matrix by pricing tier.
lucy: mitigation options we can act on quickly: 1) force intra-region routing to avoid cross-AZ egress where possible 2) increase prefix/KV caching for hot prompts 3) shift large batch jobs to cheaper regions (us-west) 4) ask provider for a surcharge waiver or committed-usage discount for network fees.
aj: technical notes: forcing intra-region routing is feasible but will require a config rollout and can cause small latency regressions for some customers. Caching bump is low-risk and can be canaried. Moving workloads is operationally heavier (data residency + latency).
ops-oncall: if we plan a routing or caching deploy, need a 2-hour window and runbook — possible tomorrow morning CET. :eyes:
mara: finance preference: try negotiation + pass-through for Enterprise customers, absorb or progressive surcharge for PLG tiers while we implement caching. Need hard numbers for each tier (PLG free, Starter, Growth, Enterprise) — delta per unit and monthly delta per cohort.
sanjay: I'll assemble a spreadsheet: columns = tier, avg requests/mo, avg egress GB/mo, delta/mo, delta/unit, impact on gross margin. Will share a draft in ~4 hours.
lucy: exporting top-10 EU customers by egress now — uploading to internal report: https://redwood.internal/reports/eu-egress (internal link).
aj: also flagging clusters with high cross-AZ chatter — will open a PR to add a routing policy toggle to console.
mara: thanks. Can we get a prioritized action list by EOD? 1) negotiates lifts 2) caching canary 3) pricing/packaging proposal 4) region shift plan for big batches.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll block deploy window 09:00-11:00 CET tomorrow for caching toggle.
sanjay: opening RFC for temporary surcharge + packaging note, will attach the spreadsheet.
mara: scheduling a 30m sync 09:30 CET tomorrow to review numbers and next steps. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
